result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but one element is visibly broken: the circular button in the top-right header shows only a red notification dot on an empty grey circle, with its icon missing. The clipped carousel item, clipped chip and cut-off pizza card are expected scroll behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The circular button at the top right of the header (beside the delivery address) is an empty light-grey circle with only a red badge dot. The icon inside it (probably a notification bell or cart) has not rendered, so the button's purpose cannot be identified.
issues.suggestion: Check that the icon asset or icon font glyph for this header button loads and renders correctly, and that its tint colour is not matching the background. Add a fallback icon and an accessible label so the button stays identifiable.
